body:
Parent: #3551. Current master `b19b3dc715691b871f0e3cab598ec5da8f27633c` reports three `production-source-read` findings in `tests/backend/Unit/DocumentExportContractTests.cs` (`StaticGovernance_ContractSliceHasOneRegistryAndNoExecutionOrAlternateParserAuthority`).

## Scope and acceptance

- Replace only those three reads of `DocumentExportContracts.cs`, `DocumentExportContractValidator.cs`, and `DocumentExportDigest.cs` with checks bound to compiled production contract types and adjacent executable contract behavior.
- Preserve one-catalog ownership, closed execution bindings, and the absence of process, network, alternate parser or screenshot execution surfaces. Preserve the test identity and fail-closed assertions; do not simply delete negative coverage.
- Do not modify product runtime, source-lock checker, generated/vendor files, public wire/ABI, thresholds or unrelated Document Export owners.
- Run focused xUnit tests, scanner positive/refusal suite, style, matrix validation, and exact-head change-contract/PR gates. Confirm these three findings disappear with no new convergence finding.
- Standard PR review/merge remains required; parent #3551 and full fast stay open until their own complete evidence exists.
title: test(backend): replace contract-slice source reads with compiled evidence
